title: Resource reservations
description: What's holding the cluster's scheduling room: stuck pods, full nodes, then namespace -> workload -> pod. Requests/allocatable from kube-state-metrics, usage from cAdvisor.

panels.title: 1 · Is anything waiting to schedule? (whole cluster; ignores the filters)
Pending pods
panels.description: Pods not running yet: no node has room for their requests, or they're waiting on an image pull or volume.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unschedulable pods
panels.description: Pods the scheduler has marked Unschedulable: no node passes its filters (resources, taints, selectors, affinity).

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_unschedulable) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cluster memory reserved
panels.description: Memory requests of running and pending pods / allocatable memory of the nodes that are up (Ready, not cordoned).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))) / scalar(sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))) * 100

panels.title: Cluster CPU reserved
panels.description: CPU requests of running and pending pods / allocatable CPU of the nodes that are up (Ready, not cordoned).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))) / scalar(sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))) * 100

panels.title: Most free memory on one node
panels.description: A pod only fits if a single node has room for its whole request. If a pending pod asks for more than this, nothing can take it, however much is free in total. Ignores taints and node selectors: a node with plenty free (e.g. a tainted, dedicated node) may still be off-limits to the pod -- the pod's FailedScheduling event says which.

targets.expr: max(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) - (sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) or sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 0))

panels.title: Most free CPU on one node
panels.description: Cores. A pod only fits if a single node has room for its whole request. Ignores taints and node selectors: a node with plenty free (e.g. a tainted, dedicated node) may still be off-limits to the pod -- the pod's FailedScheduling event says which.

targets.expr: max(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) - (sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) or sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 0))

panels.title: Pods waiting to schedule
panels.description: Every Pending pod, with what it is asking for. Compare its requests against 'Free per node' to the right: it needs one node with room for all of it. 'Unschedulable' = 1 when the scheduler has given up on every node for now.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, workload, pod) ((((time() - max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_created)) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending"}) == 1)) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel))

max by (namespace, workload, pod) (((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending"}) == 1)) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel))

max by (namespace, workload, pod) (((sum by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending"}) == 1))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel))

max by (namespace, workload, pod) (((sum by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending"}) == 1))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel))

panels.title: Free memory per node (allocatable − requested)
panels.description: What a new pod's memory request can still claim on each node. Ignores taints and node selectors: a node with plenty free (e.g. a tainted, dedicated node) may still be off-limits to the pod -- the pod's FailedScheduling event says which.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) - (sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) or sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 0)

panels.title: Free CPU per node (allocatable − requested)
panels.description: Cores a new pod's CPU request can still claim on each node. Ignores taints and node selectors: a node with plenty free (e.g. a tainted, dedicated node) may still be off-limits to the pod -- the pod's FailedScheduling event says which.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) - (sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) or sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 0)

panels.title: Waiting pods by namespace
panels.description: When did scheduling trouble start, and who is affected.

targets.expr: count by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"} == 1)
count by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1)

panels.title: Nodes down or cordoned
panels.description: Nodes that aren't Ready or are cordoned (e.g. the framework laptop while it's away). Their capacity is left out of every 'allocatable' and 'free' figure; the free-per-node bars list only the nodes that are up.

targets.expr: count(max by (node) (kube_node_info) unless on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: 2 · Which nodes are full? (whole nodes; ignores the namespace/workload filters)

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 100

sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 100

panels.title: Memory limits % of allocatable
panels.description: Overcommit: >100% means the pods on this node could together use more memory than it has, if they all hit their limits (OOM-kill risk). Pods without a limit are not counted.

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 100

sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 100

sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))) * 100

panels.title: Memory: requested vs used
panels.description: Requested = sum of pod memory requests; used = pod working set (cAdvisor). A big gap is reservation that isn't being used.

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node"}) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))

panels.title: CPU: requested vs used (cores)
panels.description: Requested = sum of pod CPU requests; used = actual pod CPU (cAdvisor).

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node"}[5m])) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))

panels.title: 3 · Which namespace is holding it? (click a namespace to drill in)
Reclaimable memory (request − peak 1d)
panels.description: Pods in the selected namespaces: memory request minus the pod's peak working set over the last day (floored at 0). Upper bound on what right-sizing requests could free.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(sum by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)) - on(namespace, pod) max_over_time((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}))[1d:5m]), 0))

panels.title: Reclaimable CPU (request − peak 1d)
panels.description: Pods in the selected namespaces, in cores: CPU request minus the pod's peak 5m-avg CPU over the last day (floored at 0).

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(sum by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)) - on(namespace, pod) max_over_time((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))[1d:5m]), 0))

panels.title: Namespaces
panels.description: Per namespace, over running and pending pods on the selected nodes. '% cluster' is of the allocatable of nodes that are up. Many pods with a small 'Biggest pod' = lots of small things; few pods with a big 'Biggest pod' = one heavy hitter. 'used' is now (CPU 5m avg); 'peak 1d' is the namespace total's max over the last day.

targets.expr: count by (namespace) ((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)))

count by (namespace) (count by (namespace, workload) ((((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel)))

sum by (namespace) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1))

sum by (namespace) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)) / scalar(sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} and on(node) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 1 unless on(node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))) * 100

max by (namespace) (sum by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} or ((kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on(namespace, pod, container) group_left() max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"})) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"} unless on(namespace, pod) kube_pod_init_container_info))) * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running", namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)))
sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max_over_time((sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", instance=~"$node", namespace=~"$namespace"}))[1d:5m])
